task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Drop cloths under door work area. Same rate as paint counterpart.

task_production_rates.name: Wall Masking Adjacent to Door
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tape masking at wall-door junction. ~24 sec per LF.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Bare Wood Door

QT5.notes: Thorough under raking light — ~12 min per door

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection of bare wood door. Rate per door (2 sides).

task_production_rates.name: Sand Bare Wood (120 Grit)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sand both sides 120-grit. ~20 min per door. Panel detail adds time.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Bare Wood (150 Grit)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sand both sides 150-grit. ~15 min per door. Faster finer grit pass.

task_production_rates.name: Fill Defects (Stainable Wood Filler)

QT3.notes: Fill obvious defects — ~7.5 min per door

QT4.notes: Fill all visible defects — ~10 min per door

QT5.notes: Fill every defect, color-match — ~15 min per door

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walk rate including inspection and fill per door.

task_production_rates.name: Grain Raise Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Wet wipe + re-sand 220. ~15 min per door (labor only, dry time is wait).

task_production_rates.name: Tack Clean (Prep Complete)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe both sides. ~4 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Wood Conditioner
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush conditioner on both sides. ~10 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Wipe Excess Conditioner
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Wipe excess conditioner both sides. ~6 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Stain Coat 1 — Brush + Wipe
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush stain + wipe per door (2 sides). ~37 min per door. Includes dwell + wipe.

task_production_rates.name: Stain Coat 1 — Spray + Wipe
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray stain + wipe per door (2 sides). ~25 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Stain Coat 2 — Apply + Wipe
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second stain coat. ~30 min per door. Slightly faster — less absorption.

task_production_rates.name: Verify Stain Dry
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fixed ~10 min per session. Spot checks across doors.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Sanding Sealer (Coat 1)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Thin sealer coat per door. ~17 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Sealer (220 Grit)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Sand sealer with 220 grit. ~12 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Tack Clean Between Sealer Coats
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe. ~4 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Sanding Sealer (Coat 2)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Second sealer coat. ~15 min per door. Slightly faster.

task_production_rates.name: Final Sealer Sand (320 Grit)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fine sand 320 grit. ~10 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Tack Clean Before Clear Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe. ~4 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Clear Coat 1 — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush clear coat 1 per door. ~24 min per door. Faster than stain (no wipe).

task_production_rates.name: Clear Coat 1 — Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray clear coat 1 per door. ~15 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Sand Clear Coat (320-400 Grit)

QT3.notes: Spot sand nibs. ~7.5 min per door.

QT4.notes: Full surface sand. ~12 min per door.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clear interstage sanding per door.

task_production_rates.name: Tack Clean Between Clear Coats
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Tack cloth wipe. ~4 min per door.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Clear Coat
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection between clear coats.

task_production_rates.name: Clear Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clear coat 2 per door. ~20 min. Faster — consistent substrate.

task_production_rates.name: Clear Coat 3
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clear coat 3 per door. Same rate as coat 2.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove protection. Teardown faster than setup.

task_production_rates.name: Final Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Final quality check per door.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up

QT4.notes: All visible defects — ~7.5 min per door

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Touch-up defects found in final inspection.

door_style_modifiers.notes: Recessed panel. 25% more time for panel detail.

sides_multiplier.notes: 1 side is 55% of 2-side rate (not 50% — handling and edges still required).

rate_notes.ea_based_rates: All production rates are per door slab (EA). Rates assume 2 sides (standard). Sides multiplier adjusts for 1-side scope.
rate_notes.stain_wipe_included: Stain application rates INCLUDE wipe step.
rate_notes.door_style_modifier: Door style modifier increases TIME. effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
rate_notes.modifier_stacking: total_modifier = door_style x sides x QT (for qt_scaled tasks). Max stack ~2.70 (glass_frame x QT5 x 2 sides).

assumptions.value: Rates assume standard 3x6.8 ft door slab (~18 SF per side, ~36 SF both sides). Oversized doors would need a separate modifier.
